entities.name: Kirin
entities.description: A chimeric flying species with aspects of horse, dragon and deer or goat, omens of good fortune and long life, found on Kamigawa, Shenmeng and Tarkir.

entities.name: Shenmeng
entities.description: Plane where qilin are not spirits.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: Plane where kirin live in both timelines.

entities.name: Ancestor Dragon
entities.description: Dragon said to have birthed the qilin of Shenmeng.

entities.name: Orochi
entities.description: Snake folk cut off from their ancestral homeland who appealed to the kami.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: Ongoing war on Kamigawa the five kirin kami debated intervening in.

events.summary: The five kirin kami meet and debate whether to intervene in the Kami War.
events.quote: they discussed whether or not they should intervene in the ongoing Kami War

events.summary: The kirin answer the orochi's call, refuse to become their patron, and help them understand why they lost power.
events.quote: But the kirin refused to become the orochi's new patron

relations.note: qilin of Shenmeng said to be birthed by it
relations.quote: qilin are said to have been birthed by the Ancestor Dragon
